title: I think it's time to address the economy problem on Nightslayer

posts.cooked:
Greetings.

As a guild master, I have responsabilities to to uphold and a tremendous amount of effort to put in to keep my guild afloat and to make sure the community is prosperous and with the way things are going on Nightslayer with the economy, I fear it will get much more difficult.

With the current price of things on Nightslayer, lots of more casual guilds will be faced with hardships come BWL, AQ40 and Naxx. I believe Naxx might even be off the table for lots of more casual guilds because the rate of inflation that is hitting Nightslayer.

Right now a flask of the titans on Nightslayer is 199g at the current time of typing this post. Over on Deamscrythe, they are 70g. Why do we think that is? Go on, I’ll give you a minute…

It’s because of bots. Bots are the reason why black lotus is so expensive and virtually making flasking out of reach for the average player. You know what the effect of that is? People having to obtain gold through devious means because people cannot go out and farm these items or farm other items to make any gold to afford these consumes.

“You don’t need a flask to clear the raid!” Correct, you don’t. But what a flask will do, is allow a buffer, that little extra help, a cushion and a feeling safety during progression and as someone who’s raided Naxx well over 200 times, flasks are almost MANDATORY to get through some of the content. You know who’s going to suffer? The casual guilds and this game is supported by the casual player base.

The moment that people feel that content is inaccessible for them, they will quit, thus lowering the player base and making guild recruiting, raid recruiting, auctions, etc all much lower which isn’t good for the health of a server.

Blizzard, it’s time to make a change and to step in and do what’s right for your player base. You’ve said that you cannot just get rid of the bots and you know what? Fine, but at least make the changes you did in Seasons of Mastery where black lotus could drop off high level herbs, you could get procs from potion and flask crafting, stuff like that. Those changes are what Anniversary needs. And guess what? those changes come in TBC anyway! Which is where anniversary is heading!

All we want as players is to be able to play the game and to not have certain aspects of it be monoplozied by sources we cannot fight back against. And even if we do sit there and kill these bots, they mass report your honest players and get them banned by YOUR automated system.

You gave us dual spec, you gave us ranking changes, you removed the buff and debuff cap which we are all very thankful for. But all you have to do, is give your players a way to obtain black lotus and to use flasks to help the more casual players because if you don’t, gold buying will never stop and botting will become more rampant.

Thank you.
